scope: Implementation-tool review only, not independent source-art acceptance

responses.response: Checks exact tint/emission/normal factors, direct roughness/metallic ORM factors, AO strength, ORM channel selection, all texture-info UV routes, shared image count and REPEAT samplers. Five actual-export material mutations are adverse controls.

responses.finding: Evaluated positions mixed with unevaluated topology
responses.response: Source density rejects modifiers and shape keys before reading the saved mesh; current saved objects pass this guard.
Initial converter rejects non-unit world scale; compact-chart and codec-margin corrections measure world coordinates. Final source measurement independently uses world metres.
Source/export asset-LOD sets must match the complete four-LOD expected set; empty results cannot pass. Final manifest additionally requires 39 assets and 312 source/export density rows.
Explicit FAIL with zero-area count and undefined density replaces an empty minimum; an adverse control exercises this case.
